trans-unit.source: This app is capable of carrying scientific calculations in different steps with output in handwriting style. It supports the basic matrix operations, statistical calculations, complex operation. This application can wake up through the Cortana. Say "Cortana, calculator" or "Cortana, I wanna calculate" to open the application.

trans-unit.source: Use brackets to represent matrix. Use comma to separate the elements in the row inside the matrix. Use two consecutive commas to separate each line. E.g. Enter (6,2,,3,1) represents a two-by-two matrix.
trans-unit.target: Use brackets to represent matrix. Use comma to separate the elements in the row inside the matrix. Use two consecutive commas to separate each line. E.g. Enter (6,2,,3,1) represents a two-by-two matrix.

trans-unit.source: 1, nCr: combinations, "A nCr B" represents the number of ways of picking B unordered outcomes from A possibilities
trans-unit.target: 1, nCr: combinations, "A nCr B" represents the number of ways of picking B unordered outcomes from A possibilities

trans-unit.source: 2, nPr: permutations, "A nPr B" represents the number of ways of obtaining an ordered subset of B elements from a set of A elements
trans-unit.target: 2, nPr: permutations, "A nPr B" represents the number of ways of obtaining an ordered subset of B elements from a set of A elements

trans-unit.source: 3, ASIN: arcsin,ACOS, ATAN empathy.
trans-unit.target: 3, ASIN: arcsin,ACOS, ATAN empathy.

trans-unit.source: 4, Abs: for example "Abs n" expresses the absolute value of n can also be used in matrix form, such as "Abs (6,2,,3,1)" represents a two-by-two determinant.
trans-unit.target: 4, Abs: for example "Abs n" expresses the absolute value of n can also be used in matrix form, such as "Abs (6,2,,3,1)" represents a two-by-two determinant.

trans-unit.source: 5, T: used for matrices, such as "(6,2,,3,1) ^T," said matrix (6,2,,3,1) transpose of.
trans-unit.target: 5, T: used for matrices, such as "(6,2,,3,1) ^T," said matrix (6,2,,3,1) transpose of.

trans-unit.source: 6, Ex: average of several numbers. Input combined with matrix form, for example, "e (1,2,3,4)" meaning average number of 1, 2, 3, 4.
trans-unit.target: 6, Ex: average of several numbers. Input combined with matrix form, for example, "e (1,2,3,4)" meaning average number of 1, 2, 3, 4.

trans-unit.source: 7, Dx: number of several variance. Input combined with matrix form, for example "d (1,2,3,4)" means 1, 2, 3 and 4 of the variance.
trans-unit.target: 7, Dx: number of several variance. Input combined with matrix form, for example "d (1,2,3,4)" means 1, 2, 3 and 4 of the variance.

trans-unit.source: complex numbers can only be produced when calculating the square root. Use "I" button to insert imaginary number I. This Application supports the arithmetic calculation of complex numbers, modulus (Abs operator), and seeking positive integer exponent power.
trans-unit.target: complex numbers can only be produced when calculating the square root. Use "I" button to insert imaginary number I. This Application supports the arithmetic calculation of complex numbers, modulus (Abs operator), and seeking positive integer exponent power.

trans-unit.source: You can enter a constant in the left corner of the keypad (with three butoons next to each other). Where e is the natural base, π is PI, I is the imaginary unit.
trans-unit.target: You can enter a constant in the left corner of the keypad (with three butoons next to each other). Where e is the natural base, π is PI, I is the imaginary unit.
